verifiedSurfaceSummary: Current first-party portal exposes two advertisements and seven post types. The collector preserves original public advertisement, selection, schedule and general criteria plus native date-only publication and closing fields. Only an explicit post placement joined to its exact current named-office country can qualify an India workplace. Institutional country, nationality, headquarters and examination city cannot replace role geography. Other post countries, exact expiry instants and whole-employer/lifecycle coverage remain unproved. Restricted workers without installed renderer platform primitives retain the native PDF environment limitation and current candidate counts; no browser/member/application fallback.
